warnings: missing_regulations: EMIR, UKEMIR, ASIC, MAS, HKMA
model_marked_cr_ambiguous: clarification needed before relying on this assessment

change_request.text: Please make the report better somehow

cr_metadata.summary: Update the event timestamp reporting field to capture the precise date and time of lifecycle events.

requirements.requirement: The technical specification must define an event timestamp field that supports capturing the exact date and time of a lifecycle event.
search_queries: event timestamp lifecycle event date time format
lifecycle event exact timestamp reporting requirements

chain_of_thought_explanation:
EMIR: [R1=FAIL] EMIR provides the Event date field to record when a reportable lifecycle event occurred. However, the field's data format is strictly date-only (YYYY-MM-DD), directly conflicting with the requirement to capture an exact date and time timestamp for the lifecycle event.
UKEMIR: [R1=FAIL] UK EMIR captures the timing of reportable lifecycle events using the 'Event date' field (field 2.153). However, the technical specification mandates an ISO 8601 date-only format (YYYY-MM-DD) without time information. Because the requirement requires capturing the exact date and time of the event, there is a concrete conflict between the required timestamp and the date-only specification.
ASIC: [R1=OK] ASIC defines the field 'Event timestamp' to capture the date and time of an event occurrence. The field format is ISO 8601 UTC date-time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ), accommodating the exact date and time of lifecycle events.
MAS: [R1=OK] MAS defines the field 'Event date (where applicable)' with an ISO 8601 date-time format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). The regulatory guidelines confirm that this field records the exact date and time of occurrence of the event. Therefore, the specification accommodates capturing the exact date and time of a lifecycle event without conflict.
HKMA: [R1=OK] HKMA defines the 'Event timestamp' field to capture the date and time of the occurrence of a lifecycle event. For trade updates, the field specifically requires the ISO 8601 UTC date-time format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ, satisfying the requirement to record the exact date and time.
